# Bible Gateway
> A searchable online Bible offering Scripture in 150+ versions and 50+ languages, with study tools, audio, devotionals, and reading plans.

Bible Gateway provides free access to Bible text and audio, along with reading plans, devotionals, newsletters, mobile apps, and premium study resources through Bible Gateway Plus.

## Core Bible Access
- [Bible Gateway Home](https://www.biblegateway.com/): Main entry point for searching, reading, and studying the Bible online.
- [Passage Search](https://www.biblegateway.com/passage/): Search for Bible passages by reference, keyword, or topic across translations.
- [Advanced Search](https://www.biblegateway.com/passage/): Search interface for finding verses, phrases, and references in Scripture.
- [Available Bible Versions](https://www.biblegateway.com/versions/): Browse supported Bible translations and languages available on the platform.
- [Audio Bibles](https://www.biblegateway.com/resources/audio/): Access audio Bible recordings for supported translations and listening formats.

## Reading and Study Tools
- [Reading Plans](https://www.biblegateway.com/reading-plans/): Follow structured Bible reading plans for daily or thematic study.
- [Scripture Engagement](https://www.biblegateway.com/resources/scripture-engagement/): Explore tools and resources for deeper interaction with biblical text.
- [More Resources](https://www.biblegateway.com/resources/): Browse Bible study resources, tools, and supplemental content.
- [Devotionals](https://www.biblegateway.com/devotionals/): Read daily devotional content tied to Scripture and spiritual growth.
- [Bible Gateway Plus](https://www.biblegateway.com/plus/): Premium subscription with study libraries, commentaries, and enhanced research tools.

## Learning and Editorial Content
- [Bible News](https://www.biblegateway.com/learn/): Editorial hub featuring Bible-related news, articles, and learning content.
- [Bible Gateway Blog](https://www.biblegateway.com/blog/): Articles, announcements, interviews, and Bible study features from Bible Gateway.
- [Newsletters](https://www.biblegateway.com/newsletters/): Subscribe to email newsletters for devotionals, updates, and Scripture content.

## Daily Scripture and Inspiration
- [Verse of the Day](https://www.biblegateway.com/landing/verse-of-the-day/): Daily Bible verse page with subscription and encouragement resources.
- [Devotionals](https://www.biblegateway.com/devotionals/): Daily devotional readings for personal reflection and spiritual practice.
- [Reading Plans](https://www.biblegateway.com/reading-plans/): Ongoing plans that support daily Bible reading habits.

## Mobile Apps
- [Bible Gateway App](https://www.biblegateway.com/app/): Mobile app for reading, searching, and studying the Bible on the go.
- [Bible Audio App](https://www.biblegateway.com/bible-audio-app/): Mobile app focused on listening to Scripture and audio Bible features.

## Premium and Subscription Services
- [Bible Gateway Plus](https://www.biblegateway.com/plus/): Subscription service for expanded study notes, commentaries, and reference works.
- [Newsletters](https://www.biblegateway.com/newsletters/): Email subscriptions for devotional series, updates, and Bible engagement.
- [Verse of the Day](https://www.biblegateway.com/landing/verse-of-the-day/): Daily verse subscription page for regular Scripture encouragement.
